sap-aribas4-cost-breakdown-v1.description: MCP server for the cost_breakdown_data_extraction_api service.

extractCostGroupDataForExternalAppsUsing.description: Retrieve the cost components and the associated cost group terms by specifying the document ID

extractCostGroupMetaDataForExternalAppsU.description: Search for cost-group documents associated with line items for which awards or PIRs are created by specifying a date range.

sap-aribas4-risk-engagement-v2.description: MCP server for the supplier_risk_engagements_api service.

GET_engagements.description: This API will fetch paginated details of engagements based on the limit  configured in the system. Optionally you can pass in additional filter  parameters to get only a subset of engagements. API accepts query param  $skip to get the next page response.

GET_engagements_workspaceId.description: This API will fetch all engagement project details for a given project ID.

GET_issues.description: This API will fetch paginated details of issues based on the limit  configured in the system. Optionally you can pass in additional filter  parameters to get only a subset of issues. API accepts query param  $skip to get the next page response.

GET_issues_workspaceId.description: This API will fetch all issue details for a given issue ID.

GET_questionnaires.description: This API will fetch paginated details of questionnaires based on the limit  configured in the system. Optionally you can pass in additional filter  parameters to get only a subset of Questionnaires. API accepts query param  $skip to get the next page response.

GET_questionnaires_workspaceId.description: This API will fetch all questionnaire details for a given workspace ID.

sap-aribas4-risk-exposure-v3.description: MCP server for the risk_exposure_api service.

GET_suppliers_smVendorId_exposures.description: This API fetches the overall and category risk exposure for the given smVendorId. The API accepts the query parameter realm to get the supplier details for the specified realm.

POST_suppliers_exposureRequest_pages_pag.description: This API fetches the overall and category risk exposure for the given list of smVendorIds or ERPVendorIDs. The API accepts the query parameter realm to get the supplier details for the specified realm.
